$comment: One line per release, keyed by its date, summarising what that release was about. Everything else on the changelog is generated from the package CHANGELOG.md files; this is the one part a person writes, because a release with nine separate changes has no headline that can be derived honestly. Optional: a release with no line here is labelled by its package version alone.

2026-09-10: Banner CSS in the first response
2026-09-01: Translatable labels, part styling and script presets
2026-08-17: Geo-detection, script integrations and critical CSS
2026-08-05: Consent events, live language switching, restyling
2026-07-20: Custom categories, Consent Mode v2 and strict CSP
